question: A circular diagram representing the twelve astrological signs
solution: There are twelve signs in the Western zodiac. बारह राशियों को दर्शाने वाला तारा-मंडल या राशिचक्र।

question: The highest point
solution: The sun reaches its zenith at midday. किसी चीज़ का शिखर या सबसे ऊँचा बिंदु।

question: The scientific study of the behaviour, structure, and distribution of animals
solution: Zoology is a branch of biology that focuses on the animal kingdom. जंतुओं या प्राणियों का वैज्ञानिक अध्ययन (जंतु विज्ञान)।

question: A person who studies animals
solution: The zoologist spent years studying the migration patterns of elephants. जानवरों की बनावट और व्यवहार का अध्ययन करने वाला विशेषज्ञ।

question: A place where wild animals are kept for public display, study, or conservation
solution: Many endangered species are bred in the zoo to prevent extinction. वह स्थान जहाँ जंगली जानवरों को जनता के देखने के लिए रखा जाता है (चिड़ियाघर)।

question: A person who is fanatical and uncompromising in pursuit of their religious or political ideals
solution: A religious zealot refuses to accept any other point of view. वह व्यक्ति जो अपने विश्वासों या धर्म के प्रति बहुत अधिक कट्टर (fanatical) हो।

question: The general intellectual, moral, and cultural climate of an era is called:
solution: Zeitgeist refers to the defining spirit or mood of a particular period of history.

question: A soft gentle breeze (named after the Greek god of the west wind) is called:
solution: Zephyr is a soft, gentle breeze, derived from Zephyrus, the Greek god of the west wind.
